figurative_meaning_en: To set or decline (as the sun)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সূর্য অস্তাচলে ডোবে, দিনের শেষ নিশ্চিত।
তার ব্যবসা সম্পূর্ণ ডোবে গেল, কোনো আশা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: The sun sets in the west, marking the end of the day.
His business completely sank, with no hope left.
note: Refers to the natural phenomenon of sunset, often used metaphorically for decline in Bengali expressions.
